launch.sh.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
SOURCE_ROOT=${1:?}
OUTPUT_ROOT=${2:?}
REVISION=${3:?}
source "$HOME/jaxborg-exp/shared/store.env"
export MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI="sqlite:///$JAXBORG_EXP_DIR/mlflow.db"
export JAXBORG_MLFLOW_EXPERIMENT=lstm-fsm-competence
export MLFLOW_EXPERIMENT_NAME="$JAXBORG_MLFLOW_EXPERIMENT"
export JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu JAXBORG_EVAL_BATCH_SIZE=1
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
export JAX_COMPILATION_CACHE_DIR="$OUTPUT_ROOT/compilation-cache"
cd "$SOURCE_ROOT"
HELPER=studies/lstm-fsm-competence/checks/behavior-20261108
for CELL in 49968000-fsm 124992000-fsm 49968000-red-diverse-100-final 124992000-red-diverse-100-final; do
  .venv/bin/python "$HELPER/run.py" run-cell --plan "$OUTPUT_ROOT/plan.json" --cell "$CELL" --expected-revision "$REVISION"
done
.venv/bin/python "$HELPER/analyze.py" --plan "$OUTPUT_ROOT/plan.json" --output "$OUTPUT_ROOT/analysis"
